lede: Wat Mae Kham Nam Lat accounts for 11 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Rai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1857–1960 CE (9 of 11 carry a date).
